value: **Involvement**: Teachers and community educators worked in collaborative design partnerships to center culturally sustaining, community-connected pedagogical practices and heritage languages in learning design. **Evidence**: "As part of our project, we work with general education teachers, special education teachers, counselors, and administrators and hold monthly co-design sessions discussing barriers, pitfalls, and successes related to current district collaboration practices."
